decision_rationale: This is a primary modeling paper on SARS-CoV-2 protein sequences using a protein language model. The record does not describe a substantive natural-language text component or a text-bio bridge; the “natural language” wording is only an analogy for protein sequence modeling.
evidence_snippet: “Protein language models (PLMs) capture features ... from amino acid sequences alone” and “The concepts of grammar and semantics from natural language have the potential to capture functional properties of proteins.”
